canonical.title: Florence weekend anchored on a Michelin dinner

sources.title: Santa Elisabetta — official site
sources.claim: Hours Tue–Sat, lunch 12:30–13:30 & dinner 19:30–21:30; credit card required

sources.title: Enoteca Pinchiorri — official site
sources.claim: 3-star palazzo, Via Ghibellina 87; closed August; dinner Tue–Sat

sources.title: Galleria dell'Accademia — official tickets
sources.claim: €16 + €4 booking = €20; 15-min arrival window strictly enforced

sources.title: Uffizi Gallery — official site
sources.claim: €25 same-day / €29 pre-booked; all visitors enter Door 1

sources.title: Opera del Duomo — official site
sources.claim: Brunelleschi Pass €30 includes cupola, bell tower, baptistery, museum

sources.title: Duomo ticket prices 2026
sources.claim: Brunelleschi €30 / Giotto €20 / Ghiberti €15

sources.title: Palazzo Vecchio — tickets
sources.claim: Museum ~€13.50 / museum + Arnolfo tower €22

sources.title: Santa Croce — organise your visit
sources.claim: €10 (+€1 online); 300 tombs inc. Michelangelo, Galileo, Machiavelli

sources.title: Medici Chapels — tickets
sources.claim: ~€9 (+€3 online); Michelangelo's New Sacristy, tombs of Lorenzo & Giuliano

sources.title: Boboli Gardens — official Uffizi page
sources.claim: €10 same-day / €13 advance; closing 16:30–19:10 seasonal

sources.title: Mercato Centrale Florence — info
sources.claim: Food hall daily 9:00–23:00; ground floor closes early afternoon & Sundays

sources.title: Scuola del Cuoio — official site
sources.claim: 1950 leather school inside Santa Croce monastery; Mon–Sat 10:00–17:00

sources.title: Oltrarno Florence guide
sources.claim: Artisan quarter, aperitivo ritual from 7pm at Piazza Santo Spirito

sources.title: Bargello — tickets
sources.claim: €12; rarely queues; world's largest Tuscan Renaissance sculpture collection

sources.title: Rick Steves — Museum Reservations Florence
sources.claim: Accademia needs to be reserved roughly two months out

sources.title: Visit Tuscany — Uffizi and Accademia booking
sources.claim: Uffizi about one month booking lead time; Duomo cupola always needs timed slot

sources.title: World's 50 Best — Enoteca Pinchiorri
sources.claim: Via Ghibellina 87; tasting menu from ~$310; closed August

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Santa Elisabetta
sources.claim: 5-course ~€235; wine pairing +~€50; 7 tables; 3.5–4.5h dining time; book 4–6 weeks

sources.title: Enoteca Pinchiorri review
sources.claim: Tasting menu from ~€400 pp; wine €200–500+; total ~€500 per head

sources.title: Best time to visit Florence
sources.claim: Shoulder seasons Mar–Apr, late Sep–Oct: 60–72°F, hotels 20–30% cheaper than summer

sources.title: The Florentine — Michelin stars Florence 2026
sources.claim: Enoteca Pinchiorri 3★ and Santa Elisabetta 2★ confirmed for 2026

sources.title: Best views in Florence
sources.claim: San Miniato al Monte: higher and quieter than Piazzale Michelangelo, near-identical view

sources.title: Hotel Brunelleschi — Santa Elisabetta
sources.claim: Restaurant inside the Byzantine Torre della Pagliazza, 10 min from Uffizi and Duomo

sources.title: Firenze Card 2026 guide
sources.claim: New Uffizi + Accademia combo €26/48h from March 2026 beats Firenze Card for a weekend

sources.title: The Florence Insider — Bargello
sources.claim: Bargello is 5 min from Enoteca Pinchiorri; rarely queues; world's largest Tuscan Renaissance sculpture collection
